descriptor.scope: 201 valid, distinct Chief Surveyor-General Erven references verified in thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged ranked Klipgat WUP locator. The official DFFE-hosted service advertises GeoJSON but rejects that format in actual queries; explicit native Esri JSON queries succeed. A strict reader preserves every straight-ring coordinate and assigns native holes/components without repair; native curve representations and unsupported or ambiguous rings remain unavailable. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging (42 rows over fourteen pages), all 201 fresh native PRCL_KEY reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32735 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The sampled records all have publisher statuses R/C/E; no guessed lifecycle filter is applied. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and broader identity uniqueness remain unverified.
